visual_findings: Seven six-page contact sheets were actually observed separately after the initial group1-group3 combined output was truncated; that failed output receives no separate credit.
Table4.1 spans pages221-222; resources, willingness, protection, parenting, compatibility and health are hypothesized problems/preferences, not an individual sorting algorithm.

Page225 contains map Figure4.1 and rating-bars Figure4.2. Figure4.2/page225 and Figure4.3/page230 use 0-3 importance ratings with N and p labels; Figure4.3 Estonia is NS. Figure4.4/page234 instead uses signed preferred age-difference in years.
Page242 is visually blank. Page243 has photographs continuing onto page244 with caption; zero extracted body text on these pages is not by itself evidence of missing content.
Photographs/captions on pages236,243-244,248,265,313 and318 were inspected as textbook illustrations, not measurements of any private individual.

Figure5.1/page281 is a typical demographic reproductive-value curve (age in years; expected future children), not a medical test, consent rule or value of a person. Figure5.2/page287 is a hypothesized explanatory diagram, not observed causal data.

Figure5.3/page291 contains two illustrative silhouettes/spines and enlarged lumbar regions, not a numeric data plot. The following prose correlates ratings of attractiveness with ratings of reproductive value, not measured reproductive success.

Page294 has illustrative WHR photographs and an explicit prose qualification of the proposed health link. Pages295-296 include fertility-link doubts and context/replication differences; an illustration does not resolve those disputes.
Figure5.4/page299 and Figure5.5/page305 use 0-3 importance bars. Figure5.5 marks China and Sweden NS; the text reports culture dependence, not a universal sex difference.

Figure5.6/page317 is a grouped bar chart labeled T on a 0-400 axis, without an explicit unit or error bars in the reproduced chart. Parent, Married, Paired-not-married and Unpaired categories do not alone identify causal direction or diagnose an individual.

Selected chapter starts, summaries/reference ends, Box4.1 and Box5.1 beginning, stated benefit counts and the adjacent text pages were visually cross-checked. The 76 other newly read text-page layouts were not individually inspected.
